notes.title: UPDATE: 8/09/2015
notes.notes:
[quote=Jery43]1. When shooting your gun as your ammo goes down so does how many clips you have
2. The healing spell doesnt work and there is no health pick ups wich makes the game a lot harder than it should be
3. Seems as though the enemies damage needs rebalancing
4. Zombies jitter versus walking when cluttered together
5. Since there is no player model sometimes the arms go towards the ground and you can look under the map. [/quote]

Ok I will post this in the  announcement's as well.

1. I balanced out the enemies. There was a few more zombies that had higher health all around at 600. I brought that down to 300. So their pretty much all equal like before which is good. 

2. The health. I have added health spawns in each level minus the ending level. Will get some feed back from everyone on this. 

3. The jittering zombies, I am still working on this HOWEVER thanks to this report I was able to  extend the collision on the zombies and instead of them being super close now they are spread out a bit more. This works out better than ever because they will actually surround the player now just like a big zombie circle. 

I am still working on figuring out the main issue though with the Jittering.

4. The ammo. Appears their would be a bug in the coding. I am having my programmer fix this.

5. I am still trying to repo on my end. Is this in specific areas or just random?

6. Road terrain map level 5 crashes at the end I fixed that issue as well.

I am cooking the game right now just because I did this work, and I will upload as soon as it is done, than I will be working more on the game. Don't be surprised if another update happens later on tonight.

notes.title: May 1st Full Release on Episode 1
notes.notes:
Full release gamer's my first on episode 1. 

Episode one will include 8 Fully finished levels now. Our new management team is paying off. We are doing amazing work! The first episode is going to be the full story still in game, we just cut out some levels that didn't make sense and did not follow the storyline at all. 

Weapons have been greatly improved.

The city level that was way back in the game is now complete, Fully finished, along with an extension. 

A few new things will be in game as well! 

The A.I has improved even more. We fixed the timing on the a.i attacking, A.I spawning in mid- air, and more

Fixed the weapon animations! 

Balanced out the spell system, and the Health of the player more.

Balanced out the speed of the zombies

Corrected animations that where not firing off right. 

Fixed wall textures

and so much more.


What this means is the forums will be changing, and new forum discussions will be created.

After the release of the first episode we will be working extra hard to get the 2nd Episode released by the end of summer! The story will continue after that.

notes.title: ITS FINALY HERE UPDATE 19.0 YOU NEED TO READ THIS
notes.notes:
HELLO EVERYONE!

First off I would like to thank everyones patience for not having updates the past 2 months every day.  Let me tell you it was worth it. So the following is a list of what has been updated and fixed and added. Also we are aware the continue button does not work, but the save system seems to work well. 

Also one more note we have teamed up with a Studio from China who will be handling all are animations! This includes the 8 new weapons that are in game right now with newly modeled arms and all animations for the weapons that will be delivered by the 24th of this month. So keep in mind the weapons are in game but the animations are being worked on. Also we will be contracting them out to do a lot more animations on the zombies themselves including but not limited to the new characters that are not in game, and most of all the BIG boss fights.

What we have added!
8 New weapons
1 new character
improved A.I a hair more
New Menu
New Main Menu
New Spell Menu
New textures on every menu
Opening credits movie
A actual save system
Optimization at its best ( Getting 60fps on Epic settings)
1920 resolution
Level Up system

New complete level design ( yes and I do mean new and complete) not basic levels anymore

Revamped Mark into a more badass character 
U.I work
Chat system
The key P now picks up weapons not E
a loading screen!
floating objects
and so much more.

This is not the same game anymore gamers.

A full RPG style leveling up system ( this will be explained in the next few days how to use it)  So with the spell system just like in Watch Dogs or any other game of that sort you gain XP you get skill points. Same thing here. You can purchase new spells, and also power them up. For example you got a health spell, but each time you use the spell you only gain 10 percent life well upgrade that spell and gain 15 percent life. So that kind of gives you an idea. Again this is all based on XP. 

Each Weapon which we are working on gives you more or less XP. Basically your knife is going to give you the most XP. Your biggest weapons will not.

Temp music is in game this will be taken out shortly in no way shape or forum do we own the rights.

Also we will be contracting them out to do a lot more animations on the zombies themselves including but not limited to the new characters that are not in game, and most of all the BIG boss fights.

What we have added!
8 New weapons
1 new character
improved A.I a hair more
New Menu
New Main Menu
New Spell Menu
New textures on every menu
Opening credits movie
A actual save system
Optimization at its best ( Getting 60fps on Epic settings)
1920 resolution
Level Up system

New complete level design ( yes and I do mean new and complete) not basic levels anymore

Revamped Mark into a more badass character 
U.I work
Chat system
The key P now picks up weapons not E
a loading screen!
floating objects
and so much more.

This is not the same game anymore gamers.

A full RPG style leveling up system ( this will be explained in the next few days how to use it)  So with the spell system just like in Watch Dogs or any other game of that sort you gain XP you get skill points. Same thing here. You can purchase new spells, and also power them up. For example you got a health spell, but each time you use the spell you only gain 10 percent life well upgrade that spell and gain 15 percent life. So that kind of gives you an idea. Again this is all based on XP. 

Each Weapon which we are working on gives you more or less XP. Basically your knife is going to give you the most XP. Your biggest weapons will not.

Temp music is in game this will be taken out shortly in no way shape or forum do we own the rights.
